question: Can a printed twin-rail bracket transfer each module load to the existing metal rear plate without nominal interference?
design: Two rails below PCB mounting rows, tied at both ends; rear flange with two M3 clearance holes. Preserve module positions and exterior.
stop: One geometry. Reject on fixed-part collision; no FE or mesh refinement before fit. Rear fasteners, nut access and plate holes require subsequent integration even if fit passes.
limits: No material strength inferred from ABS/PETG names
